title: Examining the controversial claims Trump is making at his midterm rallies
summary: With the midterms approaching, White House correspondent Liz Landers fact-checks claims President Trump has been making at his rallies. She explains what budget projections say about immigration and federal revenue, what the law actually allows for prosecuting leakers, and what really happened with voting machines in Arizona's 2022 election. She also covers a Justice Department push over voter rolls and the press secretary's departure.
focus: Shadow Liz Landers's answers on immigration and federal revenue and on the Arizona voting machines: calm, evidence-led explanations that are a good model for correcting a client's assumption politely.
